description: Canonical loop-governance cron jobs. Managed by install-crons.sh.

crons.name: loop-governance-health
crons.description: Health check — tests Ollama, scoring, DB every 10 min. Silent on success, auto-restarts Ollama on failure, alerts via Telegram.

crons.name: weekly-loop-evaluation
crons.prompt:
Run the loop governance evaluation pipeline for the last 7 days, then auto-apply safe config changes, and finally vacuum old cycles from the database.

1. Generate the evaluation report using the loop-governance skill (last 7 days).
2. Deliver the evaluation report including summary, trends, decision accuracy, and recommendations.
3. Run auto-apply: execute `auto-apply --json` and report what was applied or skipped.
4. Run DB retention (archive cycles older than 90 days).
5. Deliver a combined message.
crons.description: Weekly evaluation — report, auto-apply safe patches, vacuum old cycles.
